recipient_is_contract_addr.meaning: recipient argument of the redeem/mint/swap call, set to the Covenant contract address

attacker_deposit_eth.meaning: ETH amount User A deposits before the self-transfer redemption

physical_balance_before.meaning: contract.balanceOf(baseToken) physical base-token balance before the self-transfer redemption

accounted_balance_before.meaning: baseSupply + protocolFeeGrowth accounted balance before the self-transfer redemption

physical_balance_after.meaning: contract.balanceOf(baseToken) physical base-token balance after the self-transfer redemption

accounted_balance_after.meaning: baseSupply + protocolFeeGrowth accounted balance after the self-transfer redemption

assumptions: The redeem/mint/swap call is user-callable; the report does not state a specific authorization requirement for the caller.
The 100 ETH deposit is the concrete scenario configuration; the invariant is claimed for any redeem/mint/swap.
Physical and accounted balances are denominated in the same base-token unit (ETH-equivalent) as stated by the report.

unresolved.description: Report does not give a numeric definition of protocolFeeGrowth or of baseSupply values; the accounted balance is only described symbolically as baseSupply + protocolFeeGrowth.
Report does not state whether the attacker is permissionless or any specific authorization for the self-recipient call.

limitations: Only the invariant_violated impact is formalized; accounting_drift, fee_extraction, and failed_redemptions are handled in separate passes.
The conservation relation is stated at the amount level; no rate or per-share quantity is defined.
The 50 ETH redemption amount and 110 ETH illustration are not bound as separate symbols because they are not needed for the selected conservation relation.
